extracted.name: Salt and Pepper Skillet Fries
extracted.description: Pan fry potatoes in a skillet with hot olive oil and butter to make simple and delicious fries seasoned with sea salt and coarse black pepper.
ingredient_lines: 3 large potatoes, sliced lengthwise into 1/2-inch circles and cut into 1/2-inch strips
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook and stir potato strips in hot oil mixture until browned on all sides, 20 to 25 minutes.
Transfer fries to a paper towel-lined plate; season with sea salt and cracked black pepper.
